0022600007.text: The Nuggets open their 2026-27 season at Oklahoma City, which has not yet played a game this season, and Denver is without Julian Strawther (out with a knee sprain) while Spencer Jones is day-to-day with a hamstring injury and a game-time decision. Oklahoma City is missing Nikola Topic (out, back surgery), Otega Oweh (out, Achilles surgery) and Thomas Sorber (out, knee surgery), and ESPN's matchup predictor gives the Nuggets a 25% chance to win. The teams' last meeting was in Denver, where the Nuggets won 127-107, and in the 2025-26 season series Denver lost 1-3.
